reason: I'd run the free 15-page tier on one client site and see what comes back, but I wouldn't pay this month. Full-site captures only come up a few times a quarter for me, and my extension does the job well enough.
objection: It says outright it won't get past bot protection, and it says nothing about cookie banners. Half my clients' sites are on Cloudflare or have a consent popup covering the screen, so I could pay and still end up screenshotting by hand.
would_change_my_mind: A free run on a real client site that comes back clean, with no cookie banner over the content and lazy-loaded images actually rendered, on more than desktop. Then the $99 lifetime would be an easy call.
